plugins.description: Wealth 360: a wealth-servicing desk for relationship managers on Salesforce Financial Services Cloud. Case and Review agents work client requests through five journeys with cited evidence and outside checks; the person decides through a staged, single-use confirm. Includes the live desk page, chat skills and the agents. Needs the claude.ai connector "Wealth 360" (and optionally "Wealth 360 Checks"); see CONNECTORS.md.
